type.description: 'filesystem' for a local install directory, 'remote' for a hosted/cloud product, 'unknown' if not yet confirmed.

supportsAgentSkills.description: Whether the runtime natively understands the Agent Skills SKILL.md format. null when not verified.

installStrategy.description: Which adapter in scripts/lib/adapters.js builds a distribution for this runtime. 'filesystem': plain folder copy to paths.user. 'upload': zip for a web upload flow. 'manual-bundle': a single copy-pasteable file for runtimes with no file-based loading (e.g. a chat product's custom instructions). 'plugin'/'manual': no adapter implemented yet.

status.description: 'verified': the install mechanism has actually been tested end-to-end. 'supported': implemented against a documented/confirmed convention but not independently lab-tested. 'unknown': no confirmed mechanism at all.

paths.description: Filesystem targets for installStrategy 'filesystem'. Required in that case so no path is ever hardcoded in the installer app.

user.description: Per-user install root, e.g. '~/.claude/skills'. '~' is expanded to the OS home directory.

detection.description: Reasonable, non-invasive signals the SkillzForest Installer uses to guess whether this runtime is present on the machine. Optional — omitted for runtimes with no useful local signal (remote products, unconfirmed formats).

configDir.description: A config/state directory whose presence suggests the runtime is installed, e.g. '~/.claude'. '~' expands to the OS home directory.

executable.description: A binary name to look up on PATH, e.g. 'claude'.
